definitions.explanation: A cleansing agent made from fats and an alkali, used for washing the body, hands, or objects.

examples.japanese: {石鹸|せっけん}で{手|て}を{洗|あら}う。
{石鹸|せっけん}を{泡立|あわだ}てる。
examples.notes: 泡立てる means to make foam/lather

examples.japanese: {無添加|むてんか}{石鹸|せっけん}は{肌|はだ}に{優|やさ}しい。
examples.english: Additive-free soap is gentle on the skin.

notes:
Types:
- {固形|こけい}{石鹸|せっけん} (bar soap)
- {液体|えきたい}{石鹸|せっけん} (liquid soap)
- {泡|あわ}{石鹸|せっけん} (foam soap)
- ハンドソープ (hand soap)
- ボディソープ (body soap/wash)
- {洗顔|せんがん}{石鹸|せっけん} (facial soap)
- {洗濯|せんたく}{石鹸|せっけん} (laundry soap)

Related vocabulary:
- {石鹸|せっけん}の{泡|あわ} (soap bubbles/lather)
- シャボン{玉|だま} (soap bubbles - for play)
- {石鹸|せっけん}カス (soap scum)
- {石鹸|せっけん}{置|お}き (soap dish)

Note: Modern cleaning products often use ボディソープ or ハンドソープ instead of traditional bar soap.
